claims.statement: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess.
claims.statement_id: Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno.
claims.quote: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess who became the most popular and enduring of all the Egyptian deities.

claims.statement: Isis's name is first attested in the Fifth Dynasty Pyramid Texts.
claims.statement_id: Nama Isis pertama kali tercatat dalam Teks Piramida dari dinasti kelima.
claims.quote: Isis’ name is first attested in the fifth dynasty in the Pyramid texts.

claims.statement: Isis is the wife of Osiris and mother of Horus.
claims.statement_id: Isis adalah istri Osiris dan ibu Horus.
claims.quote: She was the wife of Osiris and the mother of Horus, and thus was symbolically mother to the pharaoh.

claims.statement: According to the myth, Isis revived Osiris after Seth killed him.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos, Isis menghidupkan kembali Osiris setelah dibunuh Seth.
claims.quote: According to this myth Isis was able to revive Osiris after he had been killed by his brother Seth and she became pregnant with their son Horus.

claims.statement: Isis nurtured Horus and protected him from Seth.
claims.statement_id: Isis membesarkan Horus dan melindunginya dari Seth.
claims.quote: After Horus’ birth, Isis nurtured her child and protected him from Seth and other dangers.

claims.statement: A statuette shows Isis nursing Horus.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah patung kecil menunjukkan Isis menyusui putranya Horus.
claims.quote: This statuette shows the goddess in her most beloved pose, nursing her son Horus (known also as the lactans pose).

claims.statement: Isis's cult began in the Nile Delta and spread throughout Egypt.
claims.statement_id: Kultus Isis bermula di Delta Nil dan akhirnya menyebar ke seluruh Mesir.
claims.quote: Her cult began in the Nile Delta and her most important sanctuary was there at the shrine of Behbeit El-Hagar, but worship of Isis eventually spread to all parts of Egypt.

claims.statement: Statuettes of Isis and Horus emphasize her role as life-giver and protector.
claims.statement_id: Patung-patung Isis bersama Horus menonjolkan perannya sebagai pemberi kehidupan dan pelindung.
claims.quote: The abundance of statuettes in this particular pose demonstrate some of the qualities for which Isis was most valued in the first millennium BC: her role as a life-giver and protector.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, her name comes from the Egyptian Eset ("the seat"), referring to her stability and also the throne of Egypt, as she was considered the mother of every pharaoh through the king's association with Horus, her son.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, namanya berasal dari kata Mesir Eset ("tempat duduk"), yang merujuk pada kestabilannya dan juga takhta Mesir, karena ia dianggap ibu setiap firaun lewat kaitan raja dengan Horus, putranya.
claims.quote: Her name comes from the Egyptian Eset, ("the seat") which referred to her stability and also the throne of Egypt as she was considered the mother of every pharaoh through the king's association with Horus, Isis' son.

claims.statement: Isis's symbols are the scorpion (who kept her safe in hiding), the kite (a kind of falcon whose shape she assumed in bringing her husband back to life), the empty throne, and the sistrum.
claims.statement_id: Lambang Isis adalah kalajengking (yang menjaganya saat bersembunyi), kite (sejenis elang yang wujudnya ia ambil untuk menghidupkan suaminya), takhta kosong, dan sistrum.
claims.quote: Her symbols are the scorpion (who kept her safe when she was in hiding), the kite (a kind of falcon whose shape she assumed in bringing her husband back to life), the empty throne, and the sistrum.

claims.statement: Isis was also known as Weret-Kekau ("the Great Magic") for her power and Mut-Netjer, "Mother of the Gods", and had many names depending on the role she was fulfilling.
claims.statement_id: Isis juga dikenal sebagai Weret-Kekau ("Sihir Agung") karena kekuatannya dan Mut-Netjer, "Ibu Para Dewa", serta punya banyak nama menurut peran yang sedang dijalankannya.
claims.quote: She was also known as Weret-Kekau ("the Great Magic") for her power and Mut-Netjer, "Mother of the Gods" but was known by many names depending on which role she was fulfilling at the moment.

claims.statement: In time Isis became so popular that all gods were considered mere aspects of her and she was the only Egyptian deity worshiped by everyone in the country.
claims.statement_id: Lama-kelamaan Isis begitu populer sehingga semua dewa dianggap sekadar aspek Isis dan ia satu-satunya dewa Mesir yang dipuja semua orang di negeri itu.
claims.quote: In time, she became so popular that all gods were considered mere aspects of Isis and she was the only Egyptian deity worshiped by everyone in the country.

claims.statement: Like the Eleusinian Mysteries, the cult of Isis grew into a mystery religion promising the secrets of life and death to initiates, who were sworn to secrecy.
claims.statement_id: Seperti Misteri Eleusis, kultus Isis tumbuh menjadi agama misteri yang menjanjikan rahasia hidup dan mati kepada para peserta inisiasi, yang disumpah merahasiakannya.
claims.quote: Like the Eleusinian Mysteries, the Cult of Isis grew into a Mystery Religion promising the secrets of life and death to initiates, who were then sworn to secrecy.

claims.statement: Her temple on the island of Philae in Upper Egypt remained an active pilgrimage site for thousands of years until closed in the 6th century CE by the Christian emperor Justinian.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Isis di pulau Philae di Mesir Hulu tetap menjadi tempat ziarah selama ribuan tahun hingga ditutup pada abad ke-6 M oleh kaisar Kristen Justinian.
claims.quote: Her temple on the island of Philae in Upper Egypt would remain an active pilgrimage site for thousands of years until closed in the 6th century CE by the Christian emperor Justinian.

claims.statement: Isis eventually became associated with the sea and was protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble.
claims.statement_id: Isis akhirnya dikaitkan dengan laut dan menjadi pelindung pelaut dan pedagang yang memakai jimat untuknya dan memohon bantuannya saat bahaya.
claims.quote: Eventually, she became associated with the sea and was a protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble (attested to by archaeological evidence).

claims.statement: Unlike other Egyptian gods, Isis transcended national borders and was worshiped by Greeks and Romans, who believed in her as the supreme deity who created the world.
claims.statement_id: Berbeda dari dewa Mesir lainnya, Isis melampaui batas negara dan dipuja orang Yunani dan Romawi yang meyakininya sebagai dewa tertinggi pencipta dunia.
claims.quote: Unlike the other gods of Egypt, Isis transcended national borders and was worshiped by the Greeks and the Romans who believed in her as the supreme deity who created the world.

claims.statement: Set was jealous of his brother's power and prestige and plotted to get rid of him, having a beautiful coffin made to Osiris's exact height.
claims.statement_id: Set iri pada kekuasaan dan gengsi saudaranya dan merencanakan menyingkirkannya, dengan membuat peti mati indah seukuran tinggi Osiris.
claims.quote: Set was jealous of his brother's power and prestige, however, and so conceived a plan to get rid of him. He had a beautiful coffin made to Osiris' exact height

claims.statement: Isis was distraught when her husband went missing and searched all through Egypt without success.
claims.statement_id: Isis sangat bersedih ketika suaminya hilang dan mencarinya ke seluruh Mesir tanpa hasil.
claims.quote: Isis was distraught when she found her husband was missing and went searching for him all through Egypt without success.

claims.statement: Isis cut Osiris from the tree and carried his body back to Egypt, hiding him from Set in the swampy region of the Nile Delta.
claims.statement_id: Isis mengeluarkan Osiris dari pohon dan membawa jasadnya kembali ke Mesir, menyembunyikannya dari Set di rawa-rawa Delta Nil.
claims.quote: After leaving the court, Isis cut Osiris from the tree and carried his body back to Egypt where she hid him from Set in the swampy region of the Nile Delta.

claims.statement: Isis was still able to revive Osiris and, in the form of a kite, flew around him and became pregnant with a son, Horus.
claims.statement_id: Isis berhasil menghidupkan kembali Osiris, mengambil wujud kite (sejenis elang), terbang mengelilinginya, dan mengandung putra, Horus.
claims.quote: Isis still was able to revive Osiris and, once he was alive, she assumed the form of a kite and flew around him, drew the seed from his body into her own, and became pregnant with a son, Horus

claims.statement: Though alive again, Osiris was incomplete and could no longer rule the living; he withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.
claims.statement_id: Meski hidup lagi, Osiris tidak lengkap dan tak bisa lagi memerintah dunia orang hidup; ia mundur ke alam baka dan menjadi Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
claims.quote: Even though Osiris now lived, he was incomplete and could no longer rule the land of the living. He withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

claims.statement: Fearing what Set might do, Isis hid Horus in the swamps of Egypt until he was grown; Horus then emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world.
claims.statement_id: Karena takut akan perbuatan Set, Isis menyembunyikan Horus di rawa-rawa Mesir sampai dewasa; Horus lalu muncul sebagai prajurit perkasa dan melawan Set demi menguasai dunia.
claims.quote: Isis, fearing what Set might do to her son, hid Horus among the swamps of Egypt until he was grown. At that point, Horus emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world.

claims.statement: In the story of Isis and the Seven Scorpions, Isis called each scorpion by its secret name, dominating them, and recited spells of great magic; the poison left the child's body and he revived.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Isis dan Tujuh Kalajengking, Isis memanggil tiap kalajengking dengan nama rahasianya sehingga menundukkan mereka, melafalkan mantra sihir agung, dan racun lenyap dari tubuh anak itu sehingga ia sadar kembali.
claims.quote: Isis took the child in her arms and called each of the scorpions by their secret name, thereby dominating them and neutralizing their power, and recited spells of great magic. The poison evaporated, leaving the child's body, and he revived.

claims.statement: When Horus was an infant and Isis was hiding him in the swamp from Set, seven scorpions kept her company and formed a kind of bodyguard around her when she went out for food in the evenings.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Horus masih bayi dan Isis menyembunyikannya di rawa dari Set, tujuh kalajengking menemaninya dan membentuk semacam pengawal di sekelilingnya saat ia keluar mencari makan pada malam hari.
claims.quote: The story relates how, when Horus was an infant and Isis was hiding him in the swamp lands from Set, seven scorpions kept her company. She would sometimes go out in the evenings for food, and the scorpions would form a kind of bodyguard around her.

claims.statement: When Alexander the Great conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with the Greek goddess Demeter.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Aleksander Agung menaklukkan Mesir pada 331 SM, pasukannya mengaitkan Isis dengan dewi Yunani Demeter.
claims.quote: When Alexander the Great (l. 356-323 BCE) conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with the popular Greek goddess Demeter.

claims.statement: Under Caligula (37-41 CE) the worship of Isis in Rome was firmly established by the emperor through the Isiac Festival in her honor.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa Caligula (37-41 M) pemujaan Isis di Roma dikukuhkan oleh kaisar lewat Festival Isiak.
claims.quote: under the reign of Caligula (r. 37-41 CE) the worship of Isis in Rome was firmly established by the emperor through the Isiac Festival in her honor.

claims.statement: A temple of Isis has been found in Pompeii, and another at the Roman site of Londinium (modern London) in Great Britain.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Isis ditemukan di Pompeii dan di situs Romawi Londinium (London modern) di Britania Raya.
claims.quote: A temple of Isis has been found in Pompeii, and another in Great Britain at the Roman site of Londinium (modern London).

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, her cult in Rome was the greatest rival of the young Christian religion, which drew on the image of Isis and the child-god Horus for the Madonna with the Christ child.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kultus Isis di Roma adalah saingan terbesar agama Kristen yang masih muda, yang meminjam citra Isis dan Horus kecil untuk penggambaran Madonna dengan bayi Kristus.
claims.quote: Her cult in Rome was the greatest rival to the young religion of Christianity, which drew upon the image of Isis and the child-god Horus for the depiction of the Madonna with the Christ child.

claims.statement: Philae continued as a vital site dedicated to Isis until the emperor Justinian closed it in 529 CE.
claims.statement_id: Philae tetap menjadi situs penting bagi Isis hingga kaisar Justinian menutupnya pada 529 M.
claims.quote: Philae continued as a vital site dedicated to Isis until the emperor Justinian closed it, along with other important centers of learning and worship in 529 CE.

claims.statement: Nephthys was never depicted as evil to Isis's good but was associated with death while Isis was associated with life, so the two sister-deities symbolized cosmic balance.
claims.statement_id: Nephthys tidak pernah digambarkan jahat bagi Isis yang baik, melainkan dikaitkan dengan kematian sedangkan Isis dengan kehidupan, sehingga kedua dewi bersaudari itu melambangkan keseimbangan kosmis.
claims.quote: Nephthys was never depicted as evil to Isis' good but was associated with death while Isis with life and so these two sister-deities symbolized cosmic balance.

claims.statement: Isis, her husband, and her son replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons, the most popular trinity of gods in Egypt.
claims.statement_id: Isis bersama suami dan putranya menggantikan Triad Thebes (Amon, Mut, dan Khons), trinitas dewa yang paling populer di Mesir.
claims.quote: She and her husband and son replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons, who had been the most popular trinity of gods in Egypt.

claims.statement: As the goddess who brought the yearly Nile inundation that fertilized the land she was Sati, and as the goddess who created and preserved life she was Ankhet.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewi pembawa banjir tahunan Sungai Nil yang menyuburkan tanah ia disebut Sati, dan sebagai dewi yang menciptakan dan memelihara kehidupan ia disebut Ankhet.
claims.quote: As the goddess who brought the yearly inundation of the Nile which fertilized the land she was Sati, for example, and as the goddess who created and preserved life she was Ankhet, and so on.

claims.statement: Isis is regularly portrayed as a selfless, giving mother, wife, and protectress who puts others' interests and well-being ahead of her own.
claims.statement_id: Isis biasanya digambarkan sebagai ibu, istri, dan pelindung yang tanpa pamrih, murah hati, dan mengutamakan kepentingan orang lain.
claims.quote: She is regularly portrayed as the selfless, giving, mother, wife, and protectress, who places other's interests and well-being ahead of her own.

claims.statement: Nut gave birth to five children by Geb: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, and Horus (known as Horus the Elder).
claims.statement_id: Nut melahirkan lima anak dari Geb: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, dan Horus (Horus yang Tua).
claims.quote: Nut, however, was already pregnant by Geb and soon gave birth to five children: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, and Horus (known as Horus the Elder).

claims.statement: Osiris married Isis and, as the firstborn, ruled as Lord of the Earth with Isis as his queen and consort.
claims.statement_id: Osiris menikahi Isis dan, sebagai anak sulung, memerintah sebagai Penguasa Bumi dengan Isis sebagai ratu dan pendampingnya.
claims.quote: Osiris married Isis and, as the first born, assumed rule as Lord of the Earth, with Isis as his queen and consort.

claims.statement: In Adlington's translation of Apuleius, the goddess calls herself the natural mother of all things, mistress of all the elements, the initial progeny of worlds, chief of divine powers, and Queen of heaven.
claims.statement_id: Dalam terjemahan Adlington atas karya Apuleius, sang dewi menyebut dirinya ibu alami segala sesuatu, penguasa semua unsur, keturunan awal dunia, pemimpin kuasa ilahi, dan Ratu Langit.
claims.quote: I am she that is the naturall mother of all things, mistresse and governesse of all the Elements, the initiall progeny of worlds, chiefe of powers divine, Queene of heaven!

claims.statement: In Apuleius's work the goddess declares that at her will the planets of the air, the wholesome winds of the seas, and the silences of hell are disposed.
claims.statement_id: Sang dewi dalam karya Apuleius menyatakan bahwa atas kehendaknya planet-planet langit, angin laut yang menyehatkan, dan kesunyian neraka diatur.
claims.quote: at my will the planets of the ayre, the wholesome winds of the Seas, and the silences of hell be diposed

claims.statement: In Apuleius's work the goddess says she is worshipped under many names: the Phrygians call her mother of the Gods, the Athenians Minerva, the Cyprians Venus, and so on.
claims.statement_id: Dalam karya Apuleius sang dewi menyebut bahwa ia dipuja dengan banyak nama: bangsa Frigia menyebutnya ibu para dewa, orang Athena Minerva, orang Siprus Venus, dan seterusnya.
claims.quote: for the Phrygians call me the mother of the Gods: the Athenians, Minerva: the Cyprians, Venus: the Candians, Diana: the Sicilians Proserpina: the Eleusians, Ceres: some Juno, other Bellona, other Hecate

claims.statement: In Apuleius's work the Egyptians, excellent in all ancient doctrine and worshipping her with their own ceremonies, call her Queen Isis.
claims.statement_id: Dalam karya Apuleius, orang Mesir, yang unggul dalam segala ajaran kuno dan memujanya dengan upacara mereka sendiri, menyebutnya Ratu Isis.
claims.quote: and the Aegyptians which are excellent in all kind of ancient doctrine, and by their proper ceremonies accustome to worship mee, doe call mee Queene Isis.

claims.statement: In the vision in Apuleius's work, the goddess holds a brass timbrel in her right hand and a golden cup in her left, from whose mouth a serpent, the asp, lifts its head.
claims.statement_id: Dalam penglihatan di karya Apuleius, sang dewi memegang rebana kuningan di tangan kanan dan cawan emas di tangan kiri, dengan ular aspis mengangkat kepala dari mulut cawan.
claims.quote: In her right hand shee had a timbrell of brasse, which gave a pleasant sound, in her left hand shee bare a cup of gold, out of the mouth whereof the serpent Aspis lifted up his head

claims.statement: Isis was a major goddess in ancient Egyptian religion whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.
claims.statement_id: Isis adalah dewi utama dalam agama Mesir kuno yang pemujaannya menyebar ke seluruh dunia Yunani-Romawi.
claims.quote: Isis was a major goddess in ancient Egyptian religion whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

claims.statement: Her reputed magical power was greater than that of all other gods, and she was said to govern the natural world and wield power over fate itself.
claims.statement_id: Kekuatan sihirnya konon lebih besar daripada semua dewa lain, dan ia dikatakan mengatur alam dan berkuasa atas takdir.
claims.quote: Her reputed magical power was greater than that of all other gods, and she was said to govern the natural world and wield power over fate itself.

claims.statement: In one spell Isis creates a snake that bites Ra and makes him ill with its venom, then offers to cure him if he tells her his true, secret name.
claims.statement_id: Dalam salah satu mantra, Isis menciptakan ular yang menggigit Ra dan membuatnya sakit dengan bisanya, lalu menawarkan menyembuhkannya jika Ra mau menyebut nama rahasianya yang sejati.
claims.quote: In one spell, Isis creates a snake that bites Ra, who is older and greater than she is, and makes him ill with its venom. She offers to cure Ra if he will tell her his true, secret name

claims.statement: In later texts Isis uses her powers of transformation to fight and destroy Set and his followers.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teks-teks kemudian, Isis memakai kekuatan perubahan wujudnya untuk melawan dan menghancurkan Set dan para pengikutnya.
claims.quote: In later texts, she uses her powers of transformation to fight and destroy Set and his followers.

claims.statement: Isis was believed to help the dead enter the afterlife as she had helped Osiris, was considered the divine mother of the pharaoh, and her maternal aid was invoked in healing spells for ordinary people.
claims.statement_id: Isis dipercaya membantu orang mati memasuki alam baka seperti ia menolong Osiris, dianggap ibu ilahi firaun, dan bantuannya dipanggil dalam mantra penyembuhan bagi orang biasa.
claims.quote: She was believed to help the dead enter the afterlife as she had helped Osiris, and she was considered the divine mother of the pharaoh, who was likened to Horus. Her maternal aid was invoked in healing spells to benefit ordinary people.

claims.statement: Neither Isis nor her husband Osiris were mentioned by name before the Fifth Dynasty (c. 2494-2345 BCE).
claims.statement_id: Baik Isis maupun suaminya Osiris tidak disebut namanya sebelum Dinasti Kelima (sekitar 2494-2345 SM).
claims.quote: neither Isis nor her husband Osiris were mentioned by name before the Fifth Dynasty (c. 2494-2345 BCE).

claims.statement: During the New Kingdom (c. 1550-1070 BCE) Isis took on traits that originally belonged to Hathor, the preeminent goddess of an earlier time.
claims.statement_id: Pada Kerajaan Baru (sekitar 1550-1070 SM), Isis mengambil sifat yang semula milik Hathor, dewi terkemuka masa sebelumnya.
claims.quote: During the New Kingdom (c. 1550 - c. 1070 BCE), Isis took on traits that originally belonged to Hathor, the preeminent goddess of earlier time.

claims.statement: Isis's Egyptian name was written 𓊨𓏏𓐰𓆇𓁐 (ꜣst).
claims.statement_id: Nama Mesir Isis ditulis 𓊨𓏏𓐰𓆇𓁐 (ꜣst).
claims.quote: Her Egyptian name was written as 𓊨𓏏𓐰𓆇𓁐 (ꜣst)

claims.statement: The Egyptologist Kurt Sethe suggested she was originally a personification of thrones.
claims.statement_id: Egiptolog Kurt Sethe mengusulkan bahwa Isis semula adalah personifikasi takhta.
claims.quote: Therefore, the Egyptologist Kurt Sethe suggested she was originally a personification of thrones.

claims.statement: Other scholars, such as Jürgen Osing and Klaus P. Kuhlmann, dispute this interpretation because of dissimilarities between Isis's name and the word for a throne, or a lack of evidence that the throne was ever deified.
claims.statement_id: Sarjana lain, seperti Jürgen Osing dan Klaus P. Kuhlmann, menolak tafsir itu karena perbedaan antara nama Isis dan kata untuk takhta, atau kurangnya bukti bahwa takhta pernah diilahikan.
claims.quote: Other scholars, such as Jürgen Osing and Klaus P. Kuhlmann, have disputed this interpretation, because of dissimilarities between Isis's name and the word for a throne or a lack of evidence that the throne was ever deified.

claims.statement: Isis continues to appear in Western culture, particularly in esotericism and modern paganism, often as a personification of nature or the feminine aspect of divinity.
claims.statement_id: Isis terus muncul dalam budaya Barat, khususnya dalam esoterisme dan paganisme modern, sering sebagai personifikasi alam atau sisi feminin keilahian.
claims.quote: Isis continues to appear in Western culture, particularly in esotericism and modern paganism, often as a personification of nature or the feminine aspect of divinity.

claims.statement: Isis's Greek devotees ascribed to her traits taken from Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships at sea.
claims.statement_id: Para pemuja Yunani Isis mengaitkan dengannya sifat dari dewa Yunani, seperti penemuan pernikahan dan perlindungan kapal di laut.
claims.quote: Isis's Greek devotees ascribed to her traits taken from Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships at sea.

claims.statement: According to Wikipedia, her worship may have influenced Christian beliefs and practices such as the veneration of Mary, but the evidence for this influence is ambiguous and often controversial.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Wikipedia, pemujaan Isis mungkin memengaruhi kepercayaan dan praktik Kristen seperti penghormatan kepada Maria, tetapi bukti pengaruh itu tidak jelas dan sering diperdebatkan.
claims.quote: Her worship may have influenced Christian beliefs and practices such as the veneration of Mary, but the evidence for this influence is ambiguous and often controversial.

claims.statement: Isis became the goddess of all the people of Egypt, male and female, royal and common alike.
claims.statement_id: Isis menjadi dewi seluruh rakyat Mesir, laki-laki dan perempuan, bangsawan dan rakyat biasa.
claims.quote: Isis became the goddess of all the people of Egypt, male and female, royal and common, alike.

claims.statement: Kali is the Hindu goddess of death, time, and doomsday.
claims.statement_id: Kali adalah dewi kematian, waktu, dan akhir zaman dalam Hindu.
claims.quote: Kali is the Hindu goddess of death, time, and doomsday.

claims.statement: Kali is also seen as a mother figure and symbol of motherly love.
claims.statement_id: Kali juga dipandang sebagai sosok ibu dan lambang kasih keibuan.
claims.quote: She is often associated with sexuality and violence but is also considered a strong mother figure and symbol of motherly love.

claims.statement: Kali is understood as a manifestation of Parvati and is particularly worshipped in Bengal.
claims.statement_id: Kali dipahami sebagai perwujudan Parvati dan terutama dipuja di Bengal.
claims.quote: Kali, the supreme embodiment of female power (shakti), is a manifestation of the goddess Parvati, Shiva’s loving wife, and is particularly worshipped in Bengal as the premier goddess of the sakta cult.

claims.statement: Kali's name is linked to Sanskrit expressions for blackness or death.
claims.statement_id: Nama Kali dikaitkan dengan makna Sansekerta 'yang hitam' atau 'yang mati'.
claims.quote: Kali's name derives from the Sanskrit meaning 'she who is black' or 'she who is death', but she is also known as Chaturbhuja Kali, Chinnamastā, or Kaushika.

claims.statement: One story says Kali emerges from Durga's anger.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu kisah menyebut Kali muncul dari kemarahan Durga.
claims.quote: Durga became so enraged that her anger burst from her forehead in the form of Kali.

claims.statement: Kali kills Raktabija and drinks his blood so none reaches the ground.
claims.statement_id: Kali membunuh Raktabija dan meminum darahnya agar tidak jatuh ke tanah.
claims.quote: Raktabija himself was killed when Kali lopped off his head with a sword and then drank all of his blood, making sure none fell to the ground and thereby ensuring no more demons could menace the world.

claims.statement: An artwork depicts Kali standing above the prostrate Shiva.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah gambar menampilkan Kali berdiri di atas Shiva yang terbaring.
claims.quote: She is typically represented standing on the prostrate figure of her husband, Shiva, who here is seen lying in a charnel ground, his trident and drum abandoned.

claims.statement: One of the earliest references to Kali appears in the sixth-century Devi Mahatmya.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu rujukan awal tentang Kali ada dalam Devi Mahatmya abad keenam.
claims.quote: Among the earliest textual references to Kali is the sixth-century devotional text Devi Mahatmya (“Glory of the Goddess”), where she emerges as the personified wrath or the embodied fury of the goddess Durga.

claims.statement: Kali Puja honors Kali on the new moon of Kartik.
claims.statement_id: Kali Puja adalah perayaan untuk Kali pada malam bulan baru bulan Kartik.
claims.quote: Since the seventeenth century, Kali Puja (or Shyama Puja), has been a major Hindu festival dedicated to the goddess, celebrated on the new moon night (Amavasya) of the month of Kartik, often coinciding with Diwali.

claims.statement: Kali embodies shakti, feminine energy, creativity and fertility, and is an incarnation of Parvati, wife of the Hindu god Shiva.
claims.statement_id: Kali mewujudkan shakti, yaitu energi feminin, kreativitas, dan kesuburan, dan merupakan inkarnasi Parvati, istri dewa Hindu Shiva.
claims.quote: Kali embodies shakti - feminine energy, creativity and fertility - and is an incarnation of Parvati, wife of the great Hindu god Shiva.

claims.statement: In art Kali is most often shown as a fearsome fighting figure with a necklace of heads, a skirt of arms, a lolling tongue, and a knife dripping with blood.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni, Kali paling sering digambarkan sebagai sosok petarung yang menakutkan dengan kalung kepala, rok lengan, lidah terjulur, dan pisau yang meneteskan darah.
claims.quote: Kali is most often represented in art as a fearful fighting figure with a necklace of heads, skirt of arms, lolling tongue, and brandishing a knife dripping with blood.

claims.statement: As an embodiment of time Kali devours all things, is irresistibly attractive to mortals and gods, and can also represent, particularly in later traditions, the benevolence of a mother goddess.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai perwujudan waktu, Kali melahap segala sesuatu, memikat manusia dan dewa tak tertahankan, dan (terutama dalam tradisi kemudian) juga dapat melambangkan kebaikan dewi ibu.
claims.quote: As an embodiment of time Kali devours all things, she is irresistibly attractive to mortals and gods, and can also represent (particularly in later traditions) the benevolence of a mother goddess.

claims.statement: Kali is particularly worshipped in eastern and southern India, especially in Assam, Kerala, Kashmir, Bengal (with the yearly Kali Puja festival on the night of a new moon), and at the Kalighat Temple in Calcutta.
claims.statement_id: Kali terutama dipuja di India timur dan selatan, khususnya di Assam, Kerala, Kashmir, Bengal (dengan perayaan tahunan Kali Puja pada malam bulan baru), dan di Kuil Kalighat di kota Calcutta.
claims.quote: The goddess (devi) is particularly worshipped in eastern and southern India and specifically in Assam, Kerala, Kashmir, Bengal - where she is now worshipped in the yearly festival of Kali Puja held on the night of a new moon - and in the Kalighat Temple in the city of Calcutta.

claims.statement: Once born, the black goddess went wild and ate all the demons she came across, stringing their heads on a chain around her neck.
claims.statement_id: Setelah lahir, sang dewi hitam mengamuk dan memakan semua iblis yang ditemuinya, merangkai kepala mereka menjadi rantai di lehernya.
claims.quote: Once born, the black goddess went wild and ate all the demons she came across, stringing their heads on a chain which she wore around her neck.

claims.statement: Shiva stopped Kali's destructive rampage by lying down in her path, and when she realised who she was standing on, she finally calmed down.
claims.statement_id: Shiva menghentikan amukan Kali dengan berbaring di jalannya, dan ketika Kali menyadari siapa yang diinjaknya, ia akhirnya tenang.
claims.quote: Fortunately, the mighty Shiva stopped Kali's destructive rampage by lying down in her path, and when the goddess realised just who she was standing on, she finally calmed down.

claims.statement: This story explains Kali's association with battlegrounds and areas where cremation is carried out.
claims.statement_id: Dari kisah ini dijelaskan kaitan Kali dengan medan pertempuran dan tempat kremasi.
claims.quote: From this story is explained Kali's association with battlegrounds and areas where cremation is carried out.

claims.statement: In another version Kali appeared when Parvati shed her dark skin, which became Kali, hence one of her names is Kaushika (the Sheath), while Parvati remains Gauri (the Fair One).
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi lain, Kali muncul ketika Parvati melepas kulit gelapnya yang lalu menjadi Kali, sehingga salah satu namanya Kaushika (Sarung), sedangkan Parvati tetap sebagai Gauri (Si Cantik).
claims.quote: In another version of the goddess' birth, Kali appeared when Parvati shed her dark skin which then became Kali, hence one of her names is Kaushika (the Sheath), whilst Parvati is left as Gauri (the Fair One).

claims.statement: In a third version Parvati became Kali by combining with the poison in Shiva's throat, then leapt out and swiftly despatched Daruka.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi ketiga, Parvati berubah menjadi Kali dengan bersatu dengan racun di kerongkongan Shiva, lalu melompat keluar dan dengan cepat membunuh Daruka.
claims.quote: By combining with the poison still held in Shiva's throat, Parvati was transformed into Kali. Leaping from Shiva's throat in her new guise, Kali swiftly despatched Daruka and all was well with the world once more.

claims.statement: The gods combined all their shakti to produce one super being that could destroy Raktabija, and the result was Kali (in another version only Durga produces Kali).
claims.statement_id: Para dewa menggabungkan seluruh shakti mereka untuk menciptakan satu makhluk yang bisa menghancurkan Raktabija, dan hasilnya adalah Kali (dalam versi lain hanya Durga yang menciptakan Kali).
claims.quote: The gods decided to work together and combine all of their shakti or divine energy and produce one super being that could destroy Raktabija; the result was Kali (in another version only Durga produces Kali).

claims.statement: Given all the gods' divine weapons, Kali sought out Raktabija and his demons and swallowed them whole so that no more blood would be spilled.
claims.statement_id: Dengan semua senjata ilahi para dewa, Kali mencari Raktabija dan iblis-iblisnya dan menelan mereka bulat-bulat agar tidak ada lagi darah yang tumpah.
claims.quote: Given all the divine weapons of the gods, Kali swiftly sought out Raktabija and his demons and proceeded to swallow them all whole so as not to spill any more blood in the process.

claims.statement: In another story a band of thieves prepared to make a human sacrifice of a Brahmin monk to Kali, when suddenly the statue of Kali came to life.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah lain, sekawanan pencuri hendak mempersembahkan korban manusia, seorang biksu Brahmana, kepada Kali, tetapi patung Kali tiba-tiba hidup.
claims.quote: The thieves wanted to make a human sacrifice to Kali, and unwisely chose a Brahmin monk as a likely victim. Dragging him to the nearest temple, the thieves prepared to make the sacrifice in front of the statue of Kali when suddenly the statue came to life.

claims.statement: Outraged at the plan, the goddess took swift revenge and decapitated the whole gang, while the Brahmin escaped.
claims.statement_id: Murka atas rencana itu, sang dewi membalas dengan memenggal seluruh gerombolan itu, sementara sang Brahmana melarikan diri.
claims.quote: Outraged at the thieves' plan to kill a monk, the goddess took swift revenge and decapitated the whole gang, even tossing their heads about for fun, whilst naturally the Brahmin escaped

claims.statement: In art Kali in her feminine form is most often shown with blue or black skin, naked, and wearing a Bengali-type clay crown, painted or gilded.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni, Kali dalam wujud perempuannya paling sering digambarkan berkulit biru atau hitam, telanjang, dan bermahkota tanah liat ala Bengal yang dicat atau disepuh.
claims.quote: In art, Kali in her feminine form is most often portrayed with blue or black skin, naked, and wearing a Bengali type crown of clay which is painted or gilded.

claims.statement: Kali is shown with many arms, from four to eighteen, each usually holding an object such as a sword, dagger, trident, cup, drum, chakra, lotus bud, whip, noose, bell, or shield.
claims.statement_id: Kali digambarkan berlengan banyak, empat hingga delapan belas, dan tiap tangan biasanya memegang benda seperti pedang, belati, trisula, cawan, genderang, cakra, kuncup teratai, cambuk, jerat, lonceng, dan perisai.
claims.quote: She is, like many Hindu deities, a multiple-armed figure with the number of arms being four, eight, ten, twelve, or even eighteen. Each arm usually holds an object and these can include a sword, dagger, trident, cup, drum, chakra, lotus bud, whip, noose, bell, and shield.

claims.statement: Kali's most common pose in paintings is as slayer of demons, standing or dancing with one foot on a collapsed Shiva and holding a severed head.
claims.statement_id: Pose Kali yang paling umum dalam lukisan adalah sebagai pembunuh iblis, berdiri atau menari dengan satu kaki di atas Shiva yang roboh sambil memegang kepala terpenggal.
claims.quote: Kali's most common pose in paintings is in her most fearsome guise as the slayer of demons, where she stands or dances with one foot on a collapsed Shiva and holds a severed head.

claims.statement: Traditionally Kali was portrayed in literature and iconography in her "terrifying" or "fierce" (ugra) aspect, but in Tamil Nadu and Kerala she has also been depicted in a "pleasing" (saumya) form as a benevolent mother goddess.
claims.statement_id: Secara tradisional Kali digambarkan dalam sastra dan ikonografi dengan sisi "menakutkan" atau "garang" (ugra), tetapi di Tamil Nadu dan Kerala ia juga digambarkan dalam wujud "menyenangkan" (saumya) sebagai dewi ibu yang baik hati.
claims.quote: Traditionally, Kali was portrayed in both literature and iconography in her "terrifying" or "fierce" (ugra) aspect, but in Tamil Nadu and Kerala she has also been depicted in a "pleasing" (saumya) form, as a benevolent mother goddess.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopedia.com, Kali personifies the ambivalence of deity in the Hindu tradition, which shows in the unceasing cycle of life and death: creation, destruction, and regeneration.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, Kali dengan demikian mempersonifikasikan ambivalensi dewa dalam tradisi Hindu, yang tampak dalam siklus tak berkesudahan kehidupan dan kematian: penciptaan, penghancuran, dan pembaruan.
claims.quote: She thus personifies the ambivalence of deity in the Hindu tradition, which manifests itself in the unceasing cycle of life and death-creation, destruction, and regeneration.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopedia.com, Kali probably derives from a local village goddess (gramadevata) who was integrated into the Hindu pantheon through identification with an aspect of Parvati, consort of Shiva.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, Kali kemungkinan berasal dari dewi desa setempat (gramadevata) yang masuk ke jajaran dewa Hindu lewat identifikasi dengan salah satu aspek Parvati, permaisuri Shiva.
claims.quote: Kali probably derives from a local village goddess (gramadevata), who became integrated into the Hindu pantheon through identification with an aspect of Parvati, the consort of Shiva.

claims.statement: Kali is first mentioned as a distinct but peripheral and probably non-Aryan goddess in the Mahabharata.
claims.statement_id: Kali pertama kali disebut sebagai dewi yang khas, tetapi pinggiran dan kemungkinan non-Arya, dalam Mahabharata.
claims.quote: Kali is first mentioned as a distinct, but peripheral and probably non-Aryan, goddess in the Mahabharata.

claims.statement: In the Devimahatmya (composed around the sixth century CE), Kali is said to have emanated from the brow of the goddess Durga during one of her battles with demonic forces.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bagian Devimahatmya (disusun sekitar abad ke-6 M), Kali dikatakan memancar dari dahi dewi Durga saat salah satu pertempurannya melawan pasukan iblis.
claims.quote: In the section of this text known as the Devimahatmya, composed around the sixth century ce, Kali is said to have emanated from the brow of the goddess Durga during one of her battles with demonic forces.

claims.statement: In the Devimahatmya Kali is generated from Durga's anger as the goddess attacks the demons Chanda and Munda; afterwards Kali receives the compound name Chamunda.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Devimahatmya, Kali lahir dari amarah Durga saat sang dewi menyerang iblis Chanda dan Munda; setelah itu Kali menerima nama majemuk Chamunda.
claims.quote: In the Devimahatmya, Kali is generated from the anger of Durga, as the goddess attacks the demons Chanda and Munda. After this event, Kali receives the compound name Chamunda.

claims.statement: Kali cut the demon in two with her sword, but each drop of blood that fell produced a new demon; so she consumed the duplicates, drank the drops before they touched the ground, and sucked the lifeblood from Raktabija.
claims.statement_id: Kali membelah iblis itu dengan pedang, tetapi dari tiap tetes darah yang jatuh muncul iblis baru; maka ia melahap iblis-iblis tiruan itu, meminum tetesan sebelum menyentuh tanah, dan menghisap darah kehidupan Raktabija.
claims.quote: Kali cut the demon in two with her sword, but from every drop of blood that fell to the ground there sprang a new demon. So she consumed the duplicated demons, drank the drops before they touch the ground, and sucked the lifeblood from Raktabija.

claims.statement: According to Encyclopedia.com, in the Linga Purana account, after her victory Kali became so intoxicated by destruction that her rampage threatened the world until Shiva appeared as a crying baby in the corpse-strewn field and Kali calmed as she suckled the baby.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, dalam kisah Linga Purana, setelah menang Kali begitu mabuk oleh kehancuran sehingga amukannya mengancam dunia, sampai Shiva menjelma bayi yang menangis di medan penuh mayat dan Kali tenang ketika menyusui bayi itu.
claims.quote: after her victory, Kali became so intoxicated by the destruction of battle that her rampage threatened to destroy the whole world until Shiva manifested himself as a baby, crying in the middle of the corpse-strewn field. Kali calmed down as she suckled the baby.

claims.statement: Kali is also the feminine form of the word kala, time; as such she represents time, which is all-destroying and all-devouring.
claims.statement_id: Kali juga bentuk feminin kata kala (waktu); dengan demikian ia mewakili waktu, yang menghancurkan dan melahap segalanya.
claims.quote: Kali is also the feminine form of the word kala-time; as such, she is the representation of time, which is all-destroying and all-devouring.

claims.statement: The name Kali is related to a term first used in the Mundaka Upanishad (1.2.4) for one of the seven flickering tongues of the sacrificial fire, Agni.
claims.statement_id: Nama Kali berkaitan dengan istilah yang pertama kali dipakai dalam Mundaka Upanishad (1.2.4) untuk salah satu dari tujuh lidah api kurban, Agni.
claims.quote: Indeed, the name Kali is related to a term first used in the Mundaka Upanishad (1.2.4) for one of the seven flickering tongues of the sacrificial fire, Agni.

claims.statement: A Tantric hymn to Kali, the Karpuradistotra, describes her as the source of wealth and fertility but also of renunciation and death.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah himne Tantrik untuk Kali, Karpuradistotra, menggambarkannya sebagai sumber kekayaan dan kesuburan serta penolakan duniawi dan kematian.
claims.quote: A Tantric hymn to Kali, the Karpuradistotra, describes her as the source of not only wealth and fertility but also renunciation and death.

claims.statement: Another text describes her sitting on a corpse in a cremation ground, surrounded by skulls, bones, and female jackals; the Tantric practitioner who fearlessly meditated on her in this guise was believed to ultimately achieve salvation.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah teks lain menggambarkannya duduk di atas mayat di tempat kremasi dikelilingi tengkorak, tulang, dan serigala betina; praktisi Tantrik yang bermeditasi tanpa takut kepadanya dalam wujud itu dipercaya akhirnya meraih keselamatan.
claims.quote: Another text describes her as sitting on a corpse in a cremation ground, surrounded by skulls, bones, and female jackals; it was believed that the Tantric practitioner (sadhaka) who fearlessly meditated on her in this guise would ultimately achieve salvation.

claims.statement: Because Kali is beyond fear and ignorance, she can protect and enlighten those who invoke her; she is often shown with one hand in the fear-removing gesture (abhaya mudra) and another in the boon-granting gesture (varada mudra).
claims.statement_id: Karena Kali melampaui rasa takut dan ketidaktahuan, ia dapat melindungi dan mencerahkan yang memanggilnya; ia sering digambarkan dengan satu tangan membuat gestur penghapus rasa takut (abhaya mudra) dan tangan lain gestur pemberi anugerah (varada mudra).
claims.quote: Because Kali is beyond both fear and ignorance, she can protect and enlighten those who invoke her. Thus she is often depicted with one of her four or more hands in the fear-removing gesture (abhaya mudra), and with another hand in the boon-granting gesture of compassion (varada mudra)

claims.statement: As Bhadrakali (auspicious Kali), her head is encircled by a halo of flames and she wields the trident.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud Bhadrakali (Kali yang membawa keberuntungan), kepalanya dikelilingi lingkaran api dan ia memegang trisula.
claims.quote: In her representation as Bhadrakali (auspicious Kali), her head is encompassed by the halo of flames and she wields the trident

claims.statement: From the medieval period onwards Kali devotees in Bengal have worshipped the goddess as Kali Ma, the benevolent mother.
claims.statement_id: Sejak Abad Pertengahan, para pemuja Kali di Bengal memuja sang dewi sebagai Kali Ma, ibu yang baik hati.
claims.quote: From the medieval period onwards, Kali devotees in Bengal have worshipped the goddess as Kali Ma-Kali, the benevolent mother.

claims.statement: Animal sacrifice exists alongside a less ritualistic form of worship introduced by the Bengali devotee Ramprasad Sen (1718-1775), who in his poetry approaches Kali as a child would a protective and nurturing mother.
claims.statement_id: Pengorbanan hewan ada berdampingan dengan bentuk pemujaan yang kurang ritualistik yang diperkenalkan pemuja Bengal Ramprasad Sen (1718-1775), yang dalam puisinya mendekati Kali seperti anak kepada ibu yang melindungi dan mengasuh.
claims.quote: Animal sacrifice is found alongside a less ritualistic form of worship introduced by the Bengali devotee Ramprasad Sen (1718-1775), who, in his poetry, approaches Kali as a child would its protective and nurturing mother.

claims.statement: Although predominant in Bengal, Kali is worshipped throughout India; there is the famous Kamakhya temple in Assam, and temples in Orissa, Rajasthan, and the Vindhya mountains.
claims.statement_id: Walau dominan di Bengal, Kali dipuja di seluruh India; ada kuil Kamakhya yang terkenal di Assam, dan kuil-kuil di Orissa, Rajasthan, dan pegunungan Vindhya.
claims.quote: Although predominant in Bengal, Kali is worshipped throughout India. There is the famous Kamakhya temple in Assam, as well as temples in Orissa, Rajasthan, and the Vindhya mountains of south-central India.

claims.statement: In the West non-Hindus were introduced to Kali as a villainous goddess in several twentieth-century films, including Gunga Din (1939), the Beatles' Help! (1965), and Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom (1984).
